exposure: Pain management during labor (patient-controlled epidural analgesia (PCEA) vs. no analgesia)
painless labor with patient-controlled epidural analgesia (PCEA)
outcome: Pelvic floor function (muscle tone, muscle strength)
cohort: 63 women who delivered at a hospital's obstetric department
finding: Painless labor with PCEA was associated with improved short-term pelvic floor muscle strength compared to vaginal delivery without analgesia.
mod_finding: Painless labor with patient-controlled epidural analgesia (PCEA) had a protective effect on the pelvic floor muscles compared to vaginal delivery.
